items.brief: Defined KPIs (OTP, cancellation rate, PLF, RASK, yield, turnaround) and built a 6-page Streamlit dashboard answering 3 business questions.
items.desc:
- Built a **star-schema** data warehouse and ETL pipeline on Southwest Airlines BTS 2024 data (on-time performance, T-100, DB1B), validated by 129 automated data-quality checks.

items.title: Second Prize, 11th National Student Scientific Research Competition on Econometrics and Applications (2026)
items.brief: MetroPT-3: AI-Based Operational Risk Early Warning System
items.desc:
- Developed a** two-stage AI pipeline** on 1.5M+ records, combining CNN-LSTM multi-horizon sensor forecasting with seven anomaly detection classifiers.
